packageRules.description: @storybook/react-native and the ondevice addons live in storybookjs/react-native, outside the storybook monorepo group, but depend on its packages (@storybook/react peers storybook): update them together

nativewind declares an exact react-native-css peer: update them together. Re-enabled here: renovate-presets disables them so the consumers of alouette follow its peerDependencies when they update alouette

lightningcss is pinned to 1.30.1 for react-native-css (NativeWind v5): the pnpm-workspace.yaml override "@expo/metro-config>lightningcss" (react-native-css loads Expo's copy; Vite's and Tailwind's copies stay independent) and the direct dependency of the Expo apps. lightningcss >= 1.31 makes react-native-css compile() fail with "failed to deserialize; expected an object-like struct named Specifier", still on 1.33.0: https://github.com/parcel-bundler/lightningcss/issues/1081, https://github.com/nativewind/react-native-css/issues/470. Remove this rule, the override and the apps' pins once a lightningcss release fixes #1081 and react-native-css works with it.

@types/react-native-web 0.19.3 removed its react-native module augmentation (href, onClick, the paragraph/code roles on Text, disabled on TextInput). react-native 0.88 does not declare them either (its Role union has no paragraph/code), so alouette still relies on 0.19.2. Remove this rule once react-native types those props, or once alouette declares them itself.
